verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.firecrawl.dev that indexes per-version markdown bundles (v2, 203 pages), with localized variants such as _llms/es.md. Agents can be pointed at these files directly, and the CLI installer also adds skills to detected coding agents. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents consuming these docs in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.firecrawl.dev/llms.txt # Firecrawl Docs
adds skills to every detected coding agent
